The '''Xobome system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Xobome 6]] and the primary [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Xobome]]. The [[Wraith Squadron]] initially planned to jump to the [[Doldrums]] system, but was pulled out of [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] by an [[Empion mine]], and had to enact repairs due to damage suffered.
